note: Recorded semantic review for the sample (hand-authored to match F9 acceptance: one missing exception flow).

issues.message: No requirement specifies what happens when a DBT payment fails in PFMS (account not Aadhaar-seeded, account closed or frozen): FR-PAY-001 and FR-PAY-003 cover only successful credit. ANS-1 requires the applicant to be notified to correct bank details within 30 days and payment to be re-initiated in the next weekly batch.
issues.suggestion: Add a payment failure requirement: record the PFMS failure reason, notify the applicant, allow bank details to be corrected and re-validated through PFMS, and include the application in the next weekly batch.
